move.text:
Hallo,

We don't do fancy cost breakdowns here, but I can meet you at €36.50 if we can do 14 days for payment. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €36.50 per unit.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH
